spec.description: Cancels all open orders on the account, including untriggered orders and orders resting in the book. The details of each individual cancelled order are also streamed on the `executions` channel.

request.title: CancelAllParams
request.description: No caller-supplied parameters beyond the transport-injected auth token.

warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings about the cancellation, if any.

notes: `token` (the auth bearer token) is documented by Kraken as a required params field but is deliberately absent from this schema: `core/transport/ws.py`'s `SocketConnection.rpc_send` merges the cached token into every outgoing `params` on the private connection -- trading calls and subscribe/unsubscribe alike -- so it is transport-injected, never a caller-supplied argument, the same way `req_id` (the declared `correlate` field) never appears in a requestBody schema. No other documented request parameters exist for this command.
